SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT material_code, workshop, TO_CHAR(schedule_time, 'YYYY-MM') AS demandMonth FROM ( -- 先按订单+物料+排产时间去重，取唯一记录 SELECT DISTINCT order_no, material_code, workshop, schedule_time FROM aps_matching_result_1 WHERE deleted = 0
AND schedule_time >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND schedule_time < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND workshop = #{workshop}
AND material_code LIKE '%' || #{materialCode} || '%'
AND material_desc LIKE '%' || #{materialDesc} || '%'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aps_matching_result_1 sub WHERE sub.material_code = aps_matching_result_1.material_code AND sub.workshop = aps_matching_result_1.workshop AND TO_CHAR(sub.schedule_time, 'YYYY-MM') = TO_CHAR(aps_matching_result_1.schedule_time, 'YYYY-MM') AND sub.open_order_quantity > 0 )
) base )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROWNUM AS rn FROM ( SELECT material_code AS materialCode, MAX(material_desc) AS materialDesc, workshop, TO_CHAR(schedule_time, 'YYYY-MM') AS demandMonth, SUM(quantity) AS totalDemand, SUM(completed_quantity) AS totalCompleted, MAX(stock) AS stock FROM ( -- 内层：按订单+物料+排产时间+车间去重，取唯一值 SELECT order_no, material_code, MAX(material_desc) AS material_desc, workshop, schedule_time, MAX(quantity) AS quantity, MAX(completed_quantity) AS completed_quantity, MAX(stock) AS stock FROM aps_matching_result_1 WHERE deleted = 0
AND schedule_time >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND schedule_time < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND workshop = #{workshop}
AND material_code LIKE '%' || #{materialCode} || '%'
AND material_desc LIKE '%' || #{materialDesc} || '%'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aps_matching_result_1 sub WHERE sub.material_code = aps_matching_result_1.material_code AND sub.workshop = aps_matching_result_1.workshop AND TO_CHAR(sub.schedule_time, 'YYYY-MM') = TO_CHAR(aps_matching_result_1.schedule_time, 'YYYY-MM') AND sub.open_order_quantity > 0 )
GROUP BY order_no, material_code, workshop, schedule_time ) dedup GROUP BY material_code, workshop, TO_CHAR(schedule_time, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY demandMonth DESC, workshop, materialCode ) t WHERE ROWNUM <= (#{pageNo} * #{pageSize}) ) t2 WHERE t2.rn > ((#{pageNo} - 1) * #{pageSize})

SELECT purchase_material AS childMaterialCode, MAX(purchase_material_desc) AS childMaterialDesc, SUM(purchase_required_qty) AS totalDemand, SUM(delivered_quantity) AS totalIssued, SUM(TO_DELIVER_QUANTITY) AS stockQty, SUM(purchase_required_qty) - SUM(delivered_quantity) - SUM(TO_DELIVER_QUANTITY) AS shortageQty, supplier_name, SUM(open_order_quantity) AS supplyQty FROM aps_matching_result_1 WHERE deleted = 0 AND material_code = #{materialCode} AND workshop = #{workshop} AND TO_CHAR(schedule_time, 'YYYY-MM') = #{demandMonth} GROUP BY purchase_material, supplier_name ORDER BY purchase_material
